description: RFCOMM protocol handling implementation for Bluetooth in Zephyr OS, including session and DLC management, message processing, and security handling.

methods.name: bt_rfcomm_server_register
methods.description: Registers an RFCOMM server channel with specified accept callback and security level.

methods.name: bt_rfcomm_dlc_connect
methods.description: Establishes an RFCOMM DLC connection over a Bluetooth connection on a specified channel.

methods.name: bt_rfcomm_dlc_disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects an RFCOMM DLC, handling user-initiated or protocol-initiated disconnects.

methods.name: bt_rfcomm_init
methods.description: Initializes the RFCOMM subsystem and registers the RFCOMM L2CAP server.
